metadata.title: The Fast Tree Transform
metadata.abstract: The Fast Tree Transform is a locally-aggregated transform defined for arbitrary graph geometries that generalizes both the Hadamard frequency transform and the Haar wavelet transform on the circle. The pure frequency part of the transform approximately diagonalizes the graph Laplacian; this fact makes it useful as a preconditioner in geometric optimization problems. The full transform provides an only slightly-redundant representation of signals on the graph that allows sparse representation of signals that include both edges and textures.

analysis.workSummary: 提出适用任意图几何的局部聚合变换，推广Hadamard频率变换与圆上的Haar小波。
analysis.breakthrough: 纯频率部分近似对角化Laplacian，全变换以轻微冗余表示兼顾边缘和纹理的信号。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未给误差、复杂度或近似对角化的精确假设，不应据名称保证所有图上的最优加速。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。8页PDF完整提取，全文工具/披露候选及点写AI、任意断行模型名型号、HyProver/Hunyuan/Danus补检未观察到生成式AI实际使用声明。机器学习研究题材本身不计披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 偏数值信号处理，与几何比较的直接联系有限。
